title: Chapter 1882: Yang-Aspiring (II)
content:
Chapter 1882: Yang-Aspiring (II)

Li Zhouwei did not press him. He merely waited silently, the gold in his eyes growing more pronounced. Unable to abandon his last shred of hope, Shehu said quietly, "I stole it from Shejie's Golden Land and carried it all the way to the Western Sea-"

Li Zhouwei interrupted with a cold laugh. “Stole it? Leaving aside whether Shejie's Golden Land could even preserve this spirit root, you carried it all the way to the Western Sea and just happened to find a place capable of preserving Lesser Yang? Ridiculous!"

Seeing his anger, Shehu spoke more urgently, his voice low. "I didn't find that place... A fellow Daoist arranged it for me."

Li Zhouwei's smile faded. Shehu hurried on, "The [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant] was not always so short. When I was imprisoned in the Golden Land, unable to move, it stood as tall as a person... Shejie had received it from the Liang Emperor as a reward after debating the Dao at the Liang palace."

Li Zhouwei frowned. "You say you were imprisoned in the Golden Land and unable to move. How do you know so much?"

Faced with such sharp suspicion, Shehu felt more misery than anger. Fearing for his life, he explained, "Your highness may not know that Great Liang was mainly troubled by three matters. The first was flooding, the second the divide between the Xia and the foreign peoples, and the third the dispute between the Immortal and Buddhist Daos.

“Many Buddhist lineages were outside the passes then, so the Liang Emperor invited accomplished cultivators and eminent monks from across the world to debate the principles of the two Daos. There were nine debates in all. The Buddhist cultivators won only three, and Shejie was one of the victors... He... He disliked bewitching people with arts. He preferred genuine sincerity and willing acceptance."

Only then did Li Zhouwei's suspicion ease a little. "No wonder someone of his standing spent so long bringing a lowly creature like you to submission."

Imprisoned within the urn, Shehu wiped away his cold sweat. "Later, the Emptiness Dao collapsed, and the Golden Land returned to the void. I took the spirit root and several Buddhist artifacts he had left there to refine, then fled in a panic. I escaped all the way from the Eastern Sea to the Western Sea before stopping to rest. But when I released my divine ability and looked, the [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant]'s blossoms and leaves had withered. It was barely alive!

"I lacked the knowledge of Dao arts to save it and could only leave it to its fate. I traded those Buddhist artifacts for spirit materials to cultivate and heal my injuries. Then I happened upon an accomplished cultivator practicing in the Western Sea..."

"An accomplished cultivator?"

Li Zhouwei's gaze sharpened as Shehu continued, "His surname was Ch'ü, and he called himself Daoist Ch'ü. He had a middle-aged face, and his divine abilities were dazzling and terrifying. I had never seen anyone whose divine abilities shone so brilliantly. I was so frightened that I fell to my knees, yet he called himself a minor cultivator of [Yang-Aspiring Temple]..."

"I said, 'I am an ignorant creature and know nothing of immortal temples.'

"Daoist Ch'ü then said, 'Our founding master stands beyond the Five Elements, born from Yin and Yang. He was the first Lesser Yang and Tongxuan's foremost disciple, the clansman whom Upper Azure sought to claim kinship with year after year, and the immortal lord worshipped by generation after generation of Great Liang.'

"'The mighty Guanhua was his junior brother. Zidu governed the world and revered him as a founding master. Dongwu and Qingyi bowed before him; Changtang and Wuguan cultivated in seclusion alongside him. Xu Xiang built lofty palaces, repeatedly sought his counsel, and offered him an immortal mountain, hoping it might serve as his temporary residence.'"

Li Zhouwei's brows rose sharply. His misgivings finally took definite shape. "An immortal cultivator of Tongxuan!"

Shehu's voice began to tremble, whether from fear or excitement. Shuddering, he said, "Those words left me quite overwhelmed. I managed a reply, convinced that the man before me was an immortal's emissary. I kowtowed repeatedly and said, 'My lord... just take my head if you wish. There is no need to frighten me!'

"But he said, 'Since I have found you with this treasured tree of our Lesser Yang, the only one remaining in the world, I should preserve it. It was Senior Shejie's destined opportunity. He was himself once a senior of our [Yang-Aspiring Temple] before entering the world and becoming a Buddhist cultivator. Let me protect it now, so that it too does not come to nothing.'

Li Zhouwei's expression grew grave. Though he still doubted parts of the account, he knew that no mere Purple Mansion Realm demonic creature could have invented such a speech.

I've never heard of Changtang or Zidu, but what sort of figures are Qingyi and Wuguan? They are either Immortal Lords or Devil Ancestors!

Yet judging by his words, he was probably not someone from the mountain!

Upper Azure... means the Golden Feather Sect...

The clansman whom Upper Azure repeatedly sought to claim kinship with... That means this great figure most likely bore the surname Zhang! I could never find evidence explaining how True Monarch Taiyuan's Dao principles came from Tongxuan... Perhaps it has something to do with him...

But he said nothing, so Shehu continued, "He chose a mountain, created that wondrous place, and revived the treasured tree. Ignorant as I was, I knew how extraordinary his methods were. I wanted to protect it with a Purple Mansion Realm formation, but feared disturbing his arrangement...

"He also told me, 'The [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant] is a Lesser Yang spirit root. It once grew in the palace, tended by the emperor. Wait a hundred years, and it will take root. Another hundred, and its leaves will flourish. After another hundred, it will produce one blossom every fifty years. A hundred years later, that will increase to three blossoms. After one more hundred years, it will produce four blossoms every twenty years...'"

He wept. "Heaven is my witness! I nourished it with so many spirit materials that it could produce four blossoms in less than five hundred years. I've only harvested a dozen or so in total, and half went back into nourishing the spirit root..."

"No wonder you had so few valuables."

Li Zhouwei's expression grew composed,

By that reckoning, he has tended it for nearly five hundred years, and it yields only one blossom every five years... Not even as much as the Under-Neck Feathers. Its advantage is that it requires no painstaking collection of Wall-Sinking Water, and its produce can be refined into pills or consumed... Still, it falls far short of the spirit flower the Golden Feather Sect seized from Eastern Fire Grotto Heaven...

Before the demon could complain, Li Zhouwei sealed him back inside with a slap. He picked up the spirit treasure and gazed down at it, remaining silent for a long while.

Yang-Aspiring Temple... Is this a scheme?

Li Zhouwei would never believe that someone from centuries ago could scheme across such a span of time to draw the Li Family, protected by talisman seeds, into a trap. Yet he was equally unwilling to believe that everything before him had unfolded without anyone's interference.

Daoist Ch'ü does not seem to have been laying a trap, but someone later could have built a scheme upon his earlier actions... The arrangements surrounding Shehu are far from simple... Perhaps Rogue Cultivator Yinxin had set his sights on this long ago and lacked only a pretext.

But he cultivates Earth Virtue, and has a substantial background. Stable Earth clearly belongs to those on the mountain. Apart from Tongxuan, what other power could he come from?

The young man remained silent, watching the watery purple light in the hall as he considered the matter.

Suining meant that even if we did not cut down the spirit root now, the spiritual energy would change later and ruin it. But if we had agreed to cooperate, Yinxin would have been tending this place... Wouldn't that mean he was the one who ruined it?

Recalling Yinxin's eagerness to destroy the site before leaving, a thought took firm hold.

Could Yinxin be the one who truly wanted the spirit root removed and the place destroyed? But if he really comes from Tongxuan, why wait until today? He could have destroyed it openly. Why use my hand?

"Lesser Yang... Lesser Yang..."

His eyes darkened as he gradually grasped the heart of the matter.

The key lies in Great Liang and Lesser Yang... Everyone believes it was a struggle between Tongxuan and Qingxuan. Supreme Yang's slaying of Lesser Yang sowed the seeds of disaster, leaving the Liang Emperor unable to stand alone against the dragons and ultimately bringing Great Liang down... But was that truly what happened?

Great Liang was a Celestial Dynasty! The second Celestial Dynasty after Great Wei... Qingyu Qian hinted that Great Zhao's current plight also stemmed from its ambition to become a Celestial Dynasty. Yet Wei, Liang, and Zhao have each been shorter-lived than the last. That means whoever is behind it has grown increasingly vigilant...

He spoke quietly, "When Supreme Yang slew Lesser Yang, did Mount Luoxia grieve or rejoice? How many differing voices were there on that mountain?"

The gold in his eyes gradually dimmed. Committing everything firmly to memory, he sat in the seat of honor and silently stared at the spirit treasure in his hand.
